description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named AboutSettings that presents an About or Settings screen for the OpenClaw application. It includes app info, links, and update controls.

classes.name: AboutSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view displaying application info, links, and update controls.

classes.name: AboutLinkRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for a clickable link row with an icon, underlined on hover.

classes.name: AboutMetaRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for displaying a label-value pair in a horizontal row.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout including app icon, links, version info, and update controls.

methods.name: versionString
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the app version and build number.

methods.name: buildTimestamp
methods.description: Parses and formats the build timestamp from app info.

methods.name: gitCommit
methods.description: Retrieves the git commit hash from app info.

methods.name: buildSuffix
methods.description: Creates a suffix string including the git commit hash and debug indicator.
